entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Blind, legless Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate, killed by Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Parun and Guildmaster of House Dimir, killed and enslaved as a ghost by Augustin IV, then killed him.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Azorius officer who arrested Szadek and killed Momir Vig.

entities.name: Leonos II
entities.description: Elected new Grand Arbiter after Augustin's death.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros guildmaster targeted by Szadek's ghost.

events.summary: Finding Szadek in prison, Augustin IV kills him and enslaves his ghost, then sends him to kill the Boros angels and Razia.
events.quote: Augustin, finding Szadek in prison, killed him and enslaved his ghost

events.summary: After Kos kills Momir Vig, the senate votes to place Ravnica under martial law under Augustin.
events.quote: they voted to place Ravnica under martial law under his guidance

events.summary: Szadek breaks free and kills Augustin IV by tearing out his soul before the Parhelion explodes.
events.quote: Szadek broke free from the container and killed Augustin IV by tearing out his soul

events.summary: The Azorius Senate elects Leonos II as the new Grand Arbiter.
events.quote: the Azorius Senate elected Leonos II as the new Grand Arbiter
